title: EvaluatorOutput
description: Final evaluator output for the is_actionable_revision dimension.

reasoning.description: Step-by-step reasoning before the final answer: assess the student response against the task goal, then judge whether the teacher feedback meets the criterion.

proposed_adjustment.description: How the teacher feedback could be modified to meet the criterion. If it already meets the criterion, say so briefly.

actionable_revision_score.description: Overall: 1 if the feedback meets the criterion, 0 otherwise.

KeyFeatureAssessment.description: Independent assessment of a single key feature.

met.description: 1 if this key feature is satisfied by the feedback, 0 otherwise.

justification.description: One or two sentences grounding the met/not-met decision in the specific student response and teacher feedback.

KeyFeatures.description: Per-key-feature assessment; each feature judged independently.

directive_verb_or_focused_question.description: Presence of a directive verb or focused question

clarity_of_target.description: Clarity of the target (what to revise)

reasonable_student_action.description: Whether the student could reasonably act without further clarification
